items.title: Michael Burry Is Betting a Buyer Will Pay Up to $120 a Share for Fiserv
items.summary: Michael Burry says a buyer could pay $100 to $120 a share for Fiserv. For a 68-year-old who bought 1,000 shares at $120 in 2023 and now holds $62,880, the top of that range is break-even. Here is what Burry's range, Wall Street's $61 target and the tax loss on a sale each mean in dollars, and the case for selling half.

items.title: Fiserv (FISV) Rebounds On Project Elevate As The Undervalued Narrative Builds
items.summary: Fiserv (FISV) is back in focus after announcing that Project Elevate will target US$1b in cost savings. The initiative is tied to 3,000 job cuts and reductions in senior management following pressure from activist investor Jana Partners. The share price reaction has been sharp. Fiserv’s 1-day share price return of 6.25% and 7-day gain of 29.65% come after earnings, goodwill impairment charges of US$6.45b and the Project Elevate update.
